paragraphs.heading: An event for inspiration and networking
paragraphs.text: Are you ready to create digital ways of accessing and experiencing cultural heritage, to discover new things and to learn? Are you up for a lively exchange with other creative minds, visionary digital humanists, passionate cultural workers, meticulous metadata fans and skilled programmers?

paragraphs.heading: An event for inspiration and networking
paragraphs.text: The Swiss Open Cultural Data Hackathon, or GLAMhack for short, takes place once a year. GLAMhack brings together data providers, software developers, digital humanists, artists, Wikipedians and digital enthusiasts online to experiment with unique open cultural data. The focus is on developing and trying out ideas for creative ways to share, use and link open cultural data.

paragraphs.heading: Interactive cultural data
paragraphs.text: Drawing new knowledge from digital data takes contextualisation and application. That’s why the participants in the Cultural Data Hackathon also investigate concrete ways to use this data and metadata, for example for research purposes, for web and mobile apps, in the context of Wikipedia, for artistic applications or for other forms of reuse.

paragraphs.heading: A multifaceted programme
paragraphs.text:
On 15 April 2021, the evening before the actual hackathon, a pre-event will be held with presentations and panels, as well as a virtual live performance, to kick off the hackathon.

An additional voluntary sports and relaxation programme will also provide a change of pace throughout the hackathon itself.

paragraphs.heading: Discover your creative potential
paragraphs.text: Hackathon veterans, culture vultures, tech nerds, artists, students, professionals or just anyone who wants to check it out – this hackathon is all about diversity. We can’t wait to see you there!

paragraphs.heading: Staffnet
paragraphs.text:
The GLAMhack 2021 will run from 16 to 17 April 2021 as a virtual event, hosted by the ETH Library.

Check out the official event page for details about the programme and how to sign up.

Watch the Introduction video and Hackathon trailer for inspiration!

Do you have an idea for a Hackathon Challenge? Then don't hesitate and submit it !
